description: This PHP file provides date-related utility functions for the TestLink project, including generating HTML select options for months, days, years, date/time pickers, and timestamp validation.

methods.name: create_month_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for months, optionally selecting a specific month.

methods.name: create_numeric_month_option_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for months with numeric labels, optionally selecting a specific month.

methods.name: create_day_option_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for days of the month, optionally selecting a specific day.

methods.name: create_year_option_list
methods.description: Generates HTML options for years from current year down to 2000, optionally selecting a specific year.

methods.name: create_date_selection_set
methods.description: Creates a date (and optionally time) selection widget with calendar and time dropdowns.

methods.name: create_range_option_list
methods.description: Creates HTML options for a range of numbers, marking one as selected.

methods.name: checkTimeStamp
methods.description: Validates a timestamp string against expected formats and date ranges.

methods.name: locateDateToISO
methods.description: Converts a locale-specific date string into ISO format (YYYYMMDD).
